name: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp Unit
summary: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). Its primary aim is to complete a business combination, such as a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or corporate reorganization, with one or more other enterprises. Established in 2025, the firm was initially registered as D. Boral ARC Acquisition II Corp before changing its designation to ARC Group Acquisition I Corp in November of that year. The company maintains its principal office in Tempe, Arizona, and functions as a subsidiary entity of MFH 2, LLC.
